name: Homeless Connect SA
shortDescription: A free 24/7 statewide telephone service providing information, short-term assistance and referrals for people experiencing homelessness in South Australia.
plainEnglishSummary: If you are homeless, at risk of homelessness or need somewhere safe to stay, Homeless Connect SA may help you understand your options and connect with an appropriate homelessness service.
audience: People experiencing homelessness in South Australia
People seeking information about homelessness support
availabilityNote: The telephone service is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The online enquiry form is intended for feedback and non-urgent enquiries.
eligibilityNote: Community Connect cannot confirm what assistance will be available. Contact Homeless Connect SA so they can assess your situation and connect you with relevant services. Call 000 if there is an immediate danger or emergency.
